skip_intro.name: Skip intro
skip_intro.about: Starts at the main menu, without the intro screens and movie.

fast_menus.name: Fast menus
fast_menus.about: Skips the transitions between menu screens.

no_mega_strikes.name: No Mega Strikes
no_mega_strikes.about: Mega Strikes are off for both teams.

unlock_all.name: Unlock everything
unlock_all.about: Unlocks all characters, stadiums and cheats without changing your save.

cpu_vs_cpu.name: CPU vs CPU
cpu_vs_cpu.about: The CPU plays both teams when nobody picks a side in Domination.

fast_terrain.name: Fast terrain
fast_terrain.about: Every stadium plays like the fast, dry field of Bowser Stadium.

mirror_match.name: Mirror match
mirror_match.about: Both teams can pick the same captain, the away team in an away kit.

thunder_island_walls.name: Thunder Island walls
thunder_island_walls.about: Thunder Island's open sides get the electric fence of every other stadium.

blue_peach.name: Blue Peach
blue_peach.about: Peach's team wears her unused blue kit on the field.

fair_ball_contests.name: Defence priority
fair_ball_contests.about: When both teams reach a loose ball at once, the defending team gets it. Based on Feder's Gecko code for the Wii.

robot_goalies.name: Robot goalies
robot_goalies.about: Both goalies wear the unused robot Kritter skin from the game's disc.

super_team.name: Super Team (Work in Progress)
super_team.about: A team's players become Super Team robots from a Super Mario Strikers (GameCube) disc image.

secure_stadiums.name: Secure stadiums
secure_stadiums.about: No stadium hazards such as lightning, wind or Thwomps in offline matches.

match_point.name: Match point
match_point.about: Sudden death music plays when both teams are one goal from winning.

override_retail_menus.name: Override retail menus (Dev)
override_retail_menus.about: Recharged's own menus replace the game's.

effects_volume.name: Sound effects
effects_volume.about: Kicks, tackles, items, the electric fence, stadium and weather sounds.

voice_volume.name: Voices
voice_volume.about: The characters' voice lines, also in the menus.

crowd_volume.name: Crowd
crowd_volume.about: The stadium crowd's cheering and chants.

menu_volume.name: Menus & HUD
menu_volume.about: Menu clicks, prompts and the match's on-screen display.

cutscene_volume.name: Cutscenes
cutscene_volume.about: Captain introductions, goal celebrations, Mega Strikes and after-match scenes.

movie_volume.name: Movies
movie_volume.about: The intro movie, the stadium previews and the credits.

stretch.name: Stretch the picture
stretch.about: Fills the window (stretched, or the wider view in matches), or keeps the 16:9 or 4:3 shape. For this run.

panel.name: Recharged Game Menu
panel.about: Opens it over the game, as HOME does; Escape closes it.

game_options.name: Game options
game_options.about: Opens the Recharged Game Menu on its Game options tab.
